new_value: {"description":"In python/src/lichen/schc/reassembly.py, _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager.receive() consults an existing durable _floors[key] before processing a newer counter, but it never removes or folds that floor when it admits a new context or creates a rejection tombstone. export_persistence_state() then emits both an active/terminal/rejection row and a floor row for the same (local, signer, generation, Rule ID). restore_persistence_state() deliberately rejects duplicate keys, so after any hold-down has matured to a floor and the peer starts a later transfer (or sends a newer malformed opener), the signed persistence journal becomes unrestorable and the node fails on restart. Consume/fold the prior floor atomically whenever newer state takes ownership (the context/rejection high-water must retain a conservative bound), ensure terminal/expiry transition recreates the maximum floor after hold-down, and add restart round-trip tests for floor -\u003e replacement active, terminal, and rejected states."}
